messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: release/gen2-inference-v2 -> canary 10% us-east-1 at 2225001234. Monitoring: latency, 5xx, kv-cache-hit.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 alert issued - error rate > 3% on canary group in us-east-1. Paging maria (oncall).
maria (oncall): seeing the page. looking now. any quick context?
sam (sre): we’re getting HTTP 502 spikes from inference-proxy in canary tasks, tailing pod logs shows upstream timeouts and connection resets.
evan (eng): on it. pushed the canary build earlier that changed prefix-caching behavior. suspect cache warmup causing many backend misses and increased cpu on llama-serve workers.
priya (prod): any customer-facing impact? Support routing?
josh (support): Support queue: two users reported request timeouts hitting hosted API with error 502. Not widespread but visible.
maria (oncall): ok triage plan: 1) disable canary routing (flip feature flag), 2) if traffic fails to drain, manual rollback, 3) run smoke on stable. Can someone confirm flag name and command?
lee (deploy-engineer): flag is feature:gen2-inference-v2-route. Flip via console or `ffctl toggle feature:gen2-inference-v2-route off --env=prod --region=us-east-1`
evan (eng): flipping now via console to stop new canary sessions.
console-bot: feature:gen2-inference-v2-route set to OFF by evan at 2225001290 :white_check_mark:
maria (oncall): new sessions stopped, but latency still elevated and some canary pods show long-lived connections (in-flight). draining at ~20%/min — slow.
sam (sre): seeing many TCP connections in CLOSE_WAIT on canary sidecars. possible slow client teardown; pods not closing quickly so they keep routing existing requests.
evan (eng): this matches the change: we introduced streaming keep-alive tweak in the canary. Changing behavior for chunked responses. Might be causing clients to wait and keep sockets open.
priya (prod): if drain doesn't finish in 10 minutes we trigger manual rollback. ETA?
maria (oncall): agreed. starting a manual traffic eviction and removing canary from LB via `redwood infra evict --group=canary-us-east-1 --force`. Lee — can you run the command?
lee (deploy-engineer): running: 
```
redwood infra evict --group=canary-us-east-1 --force --drain-timeout=30s
```
lee (deploy-engineer): command returned: eviction started, but edge LB reports some connections still sticky due to session affinity.
sam (sre): session affinity is preventing instant drain; we can disable affinity on the LB but that will affect stable too. Not ideal.
evan (eng): we need a quicker path — rollback to previous stable image for canary group only. `redwood deploy rollback --group=canary-us-east-1 --to=release/gen2-inference-v1`
lee (deploy-engineer): initiating rollback to gen2-inference-v1 on canary group now.
console-bot: rollback job 9876 started by lee at 2225001560.
maria (oncall): notify SRE: monitor error rate, 5xx, and customer-facing dashboards. Priya, Josh — prepare a short customer note if we need to escalate.
josh (support): drafting templated line: "We detected increased errors for a subset of requests in US East; we are rolling back a recent change and monitoring. No action required from customers." Will hold until we confirm rollback success.
sam (sre): rollback completed on canary group at 2225001800. Observability: error rate dropping from 3.8% -> 0.6% within ~4 minutes.
evan (eng): confirming: pods are now running gen2-inference-v1 on canary. streaming behavior back to previous semantics.
maria (oncall): good. running automated smoke: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` returned 200 and token stream within 1.2s.
console-bot: canary error alarm cleared at 2225001870.
priya (prod): product regression check: sampling 50 requests across routes — no hallucination or content regressions observed.
josh (support): sending customer note now.
priya (prod): quick post-action: 1) disable the rolled-out change in CI (PR blocked), 2) create a rollback postmortem entry, 3) schedule infra/config fix for session affinity/drain behavior.
evan (eng): root cause hypothesis: streaming keep-alive change + prefix cache warmup increased latencies and led to long-lived connections; combined with LB session affinity caused slow drain. Need a canary teardown test to exercise connection close semantics.
sam (sre): mitigation items for Sev0 closure: - ensure LB can do immediate drain on canary-only tags - add probe to detect CLOSE_WAIT surge - add alert for drain-rate < 50% in 5m
maria (oncall): handing off to evan and priya for postmortem and to lee for infra follow-up. I’ll file the incident and mark P0 resolved. :white_check_mark:
evan (eng): will own the fix for keep-alive behavior and add unit/integration tests for streaming.
lee (deploy-engineer): I’ll work with infra to add a non-affinity canary target group option and an emergency evict path.
priya (prod): I’ll own customer comms and the regression checklist for next release.
josh (support): customers updated. No active cases outstanding.
maria (oncall): closing the page. final note: postmortem to include timeline, decisions to flip flag vs rollback, and pre-deploy canary teardown test. Nice quick coordination — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
